item.title: Groundhog predicts more cold weather: Is he right?
item.description: Punxsutawney Phil sees a longer winter, but a local meteorologist says a shifting Arctic Oscillation points to milder mid-February weather and possible severe storms in the South.

item.title: E-edition for Feb. 4, 2026
item.description: E-edition: Feb. 4, 2026 – Explore the latest news and updates from in and around the Brewton and East Brewton community.

item.title: Richard Terry Tompkins
item.description: Obituary: Richard Terry Tompkins, 72, East Brewton cabinet maker and church member, remembered by six sons and family; services held Feb. 3 at East Brewton Assembly of God.

item.title: Otis Daniel 'Danny' Golson
item.description: Otis Daniel “Danny” Golson, 89, of Brewton, died Jan. 26, 2026; services were held Jan. 29 at First Methodist Church, Brewton, with burial at Chapelle Cemetery in Evergreen.

item.title: James Lee Jerkins
item.description: James Lee Jerkins, 61, of Summerdale, died Jan. 25, 2026. Born in Brewton, he is remembered by family and friends; celebration of life Feb. 21 at New Vision Church.

item.title: Dr. Sara Faison Lawhorne
item.description: Educator and business leader Dr. Sara Faison Lawhorne whose career spanned classrooms, family entertainment centers and corporate leadership, died Jan. 13, 2026, after a battle with pancreatic cancer.

item.title: James Edward Jackson
item.description: James Edward Jackson, 80, devoted deacon and top JC Penney furniture salesman, remembered by four daughters after his January 13, 2026 passing.

item.title: Gladys Jones Culliver
item.description: Remembering Gladys Jones Culliver (1946–2026), a devoted mother, grandmother, and longtime housekeeper, whose faith and service shaped her family and church.
